name: The embassy to Edo of 1719
traveler: Hong Chi-jung's embassy, with Sin Yu-han as its writer
summary: Joseon sent twelve great embassies to the Tokugawa shoguns between 1607 and 1811, each several hundred strong. The 1719 embassy, sent to congratulate the shogun Yoshimune, crossed by Tsushima and the Inland Sea and went overland from Osaka to Edo, greeted by crowds and by Japanese scholars eager for Korean poems. Its writer Sin Yu-han kept the Haeyurok, the fullest Korean diary of Tokugawa Japan.
